# Simple4U

> Official site: https://simple4u.at
> SaaS CRM and lesson planner for private tutors and teachers (Austria / EU).
> Not affiliated with simple4u.io (US engineering firm) or simple4u.net.

Simple4U is a web app for independent tutors: calendar and recurring lessons, student records, package balances, finance/tax estimates, and optional Telegram reminders.

Operator: Arsen Mileuski, Köflacher Gasse 9, 2.218, 8020 Graz, Austria.
Email: support@simple4u.com
Imprint: https://simple4u.at/legal/impressum
